summary.en:
- Jade is primarily an AOE specialist and not meant for situations with low enemy count. In 4-5 target AOE situations, she works well as a Skill Point positive Sub DPS who gains Follow-Up ATK charges whenever her chosen ally acts. She also self buffs herself for up to 120% CRIT DMG and 25% ATK%.
- Generally, she pairs well with a Main DPS who benefits from Jade's frequent, AOE attacks. Jade is also able to provide a flat 30 SPD buff to her primary partner, which is significant.
- As of the writing of this entry, Jade sees lower usage due to stronger units in her AOE specialist niche.

priority.en:
S1 > E1 (for Pure Fiction)

E1 > S1 (for lower target scenarios)

details.en:
- While her E1 does allow her to perform better in lower enemy target scenarios, Jade generally performs best in Pure Fiction or 4-5 target scenarios regardless. Thus, her S1 [[light-cone:yet-hope-is-priceless]] would be a more reliable general upgrade.
- If you really want to bring Jade to as many types of situations as possible, E1 is a notable upgrade.
